newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-B.Philp cuts Applied Microbio stake.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-B.Philp cuts Applied Microbio stake.

text.p: Food ingredients group Burns, Philp & Co Ltd said on Wednesday it had cut its stake in listed U.S. firm Applied Microbiology Inc (AMBI) to 43 percent from 49 percent as part of its deal announced earlier to buy AMBI's Aplin & Barrett food preservative unit.
"Upon completion of the transaction, Burns Philp will reduce its ownership of Applied Microbioiogylnc,a NASDAQ listed US corporation, from 49 percent to 43 per cent," Burns Philp said.
The deal involved Burns Philp paying AMBI US$13.5 million in cash, lending US$2.5 million to AMBI and returning 2.42 million AMBI shares to AMBI.
Burns Philp said last month it may reduce its stake from 49 percent, having sold it down from 58 percent since the start of the current financial year to June 30, 1997.
Burns Philp said it had received about US$7.5 million in cash from the sale of those shares.
